checks.check: a third account cannot request from a comparison it did not play
a guest comparison cannot start a Rivalry (unavailable)
a self comparison cannot start a Rivalry
a malformed or forged handle is refused without touching the database
A requests B from the completed comparison: requested, 7-day expiry, opponent resolved server-side
a retry does not duplicate and does not refresh the expiry
B's crossed request answers pending_incoming — no duplicate row, no silent mutual acceptance
the sender cannot accept their own request; a third account cannot act at all
an unknown action is refused
B sees the incoming request with the opponent's CURRENT display name and no id
B explicitly accepts: active, period 1 begins now
the comparison that started the relationship predates acceptance: NOT backfilled
reconcile enrols nothing that predates the period
a creator win after acceptance is recorded once as the creator's Rivalry win
the same attempt again: already_recorded, one event
J: 2–0–1 and B: 0–2–1 — A's wins equal B's losses, ties equal
the streak: a tie is the newest event, so J's streak is 0 (a tie ends the run)
events carry the code, both scores, rated flag and the era — never an id, an email or a rating
an unrated comparison counts and is displayed as unrated (no rating event exists for it)
the hook (completion) is idempotent through the run store path
six simultaneous recordings of two distinct attempts: exactly two events, the rest already_recorded
totals after concurrency: J 3–1–1
in Postgres the same is decided by the pair advisory lock and the unique constraint
C reads no Rivalry data: empty list, detail not_yours for the real id
a guessed id reads the same as a non-member's
a private opponent shows no public slug; both stay private
a public opponent's slug appears only while public
a display-name change updates the current identity without touching records
an open Challenge from a rival since the period began is a pending Challenge for the other side
either member may end; the record is kept
an attempt STARTED before closure settles into the archived period (ending cannot erase an imminent loss)
an attempt started after closure does not count
a fresh request during the 1-day close cooldown is refused
reactivation needs fresh mutual consent and starts period 2; period 1 stays as labelled history
the late attempt still does not count in period 2 (it started before period 2 began)
J requests C; C declines; J's re-request is in the 7-day decline cooldown
accepting a declined request fails safely
after the cooldown J may ask again; J cancels; accepting a cancelled request fails safely
C blocks: idle, blocked; J's later request reads the generic 'unavailable'; C's own request is refused the same way
blocked state does not leak to the requester: no 'blocked' word in J's view
C sees BLOCKED BY ME and may unblock
an expired request cannot be accepted and reads as idle/expired
B's outstanding requests are capped at 5 (outgoing_limit) before the daily cap
B's new requests are capped at 10 in 24 hours (daily_limit)
after B's deletion J keeps the private history as 'Deleted account'; the relationship is closed
a deleted account cannot be requested or accept
reconcile after everything enrols nothing new
